senses.gloss: (b. h.; sec. r. of רק; cmp. מצהב, Targ. II Chr. IV, 16) to brighten, cleanse (metal); to scour, scald. Sifra Tsav, Par. 3, ch. VI; Zeb. XI, 6 מוֹרְקוֹ ושוטפו וכ׳ he must scour and rinse it &c.; Tosef. ib. X, 13 מוֹרְקָן (not מוריקן); a. fr.

units: <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 1">Ab. d’R. N. ch. I</cite>, beg. <he>בשביל שיִמָּרֵק מכל וכ׳</he> that he might be cleansed of all the food and drink in his bowels.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 11:9">Tosef. B. Bath. XI, 9</cite> <cite ref="M02760"><he>נמרק</he></cite>, read: <cite ref="M00929"><he>נִמְחַק</he></cite>].

senses.gloss: to polish up. Koh. R. beg. סיתתה ומֵירְקָהּ he chiselled the stone and polished it, v. כִּרְכֵּם.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 33a:10">Sabb. 33ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>תמרוק</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 20:30">Prov. XX, 30</cite>) <he>המְמָרֵק עצמו וכ׳</he> he who polishes himself (makes toilet, prepares himself) for a sinful act; (Rashi: who makes himself free from all other thoughts, devoting himself entirely to sin, v. infra).

<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 1:2">Tosef. Ḥull. I, 2</cite> <he>ומ׳ הגוי וכ׳</he> and a gentile finished the slaughtering (by cutting farther than the ritual requires); (<cite ref="Chullin 121b">Ḥull. 121ᵇ</cite> <he>גמר</he>); <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 3:4">Yoma III, 4</cite> <he>ומֵרַ׳</he>; <cite ref="Chullin 29a:23">Ḥull. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>ומֵי׳</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 4:2">Tam. IV, 2</cite> <he>מ׳ את ההפשט</he> he finishes the flaying.

<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 10:1">Mikv. X, 1</cite> <he>הכניסן … ולא מֵרְקָן</he> he inserted the handles properly but did not finish them off (by fastening &c.). Ohol. XIII, 3 <he>הגיפה ולא מֵירְקָהּ</he> he fitted the door in, but did not finish it off (so that it fitted accurately). Y. R. Hash. I, end, 57ᶜ, a. e. <he>מכיון שהתחיל … מָרֵק</he> inasmuch as he commenced the act, we say to him, finish it; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to cleanse from sin by suffering, to remove sin, effect forgiveness.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 5a:18">Ber. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>יסורין שמְמָרְקִין כל וכ׳</he> sufferings which cleanse the entire body of man; <cite ref="Berakhot 5a:19">ib.</cite> <he>ממרקין כל עונותיו וכ׳</he> wash away all sins of man; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 339">Yalk. Ex. 339</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 850">Yalk. Deut. 850</cite>.

<cite ref="Yoma 86a:8">Yoma 86ᵃ</cite> <he>מיתה מְמָרֶקֶת</he> death finishes the atonement (v. supra); Y. Snh. X, 27ᶜ bot. <he>מיתה ממרקת שליש</he> death removes the last third of sins; a. fr.—Y. Keth. VI, beg. 30ᶜ (in mixed dict.) <he>ולא מְמָרֵק לה פורנה</he> and does not pay off the entire dowry.—
Snh. 92ᵃ וה׳ סידו Ar. s. v. סר 3, ed. Koh., v. מָקַק Hof
